candidates.name: Karaman 2008
candidates.reason: Same KINOMEscan lineage with major target/compound overlap and apparently reused values; technical semantics check only.

candidates.name: IDG-DREAM 2021
candidates.reason: Sparse, hit-preselected KINOMEscan Kd subset; valuable prospective challenge precedent but unsuitable as a dense crossed final test.

candidates.name: Anastassiadis 2011 / PKIS / PKIS2
candidates.reason: Dense single-concentration functional inhibition is not an absolute Kd endpoint and the releases are older and broadly reused.

candidates.name: Mills and Hug Optimal Kinase Library 2026
candidates.reason: Dense independent four-dose KINOMEscan experiment with raw measurements, but 61 of 192 compounds exactly overlap admitted Davis parents and reported KSKd values are Bayesian interval estimates with extensive extrapolation.
candidates.role: primary external affinity-like confirmation after disjoint-ledger adjudication

candidates.name: Saifudeen KIRHub 2026
candidates.reason: Orthogonal duplicate HotSpot functional panel with detailed construct metadata; not pKd, structures are absent, replicate pairs are unpublished, and Reaction Biology reuse terms require review.

final_policy: Use complementary, custodian-locked eligible ledgers: OKL for affinity-like replication and KIRHub for orthogonal ranking/classification. Neither panel may tune representations, hyperparameters, exclusions, or thresholds.
